artefact.service_description: Immunization administration provided by Summit Occupational Health on November 22, 2025.
artefact.plain_language_summary: Your claim for an immunization service was partly paid by your plan. Some information was missing, which affected the payment.
artefact.what_happened: The plan reviewed your claim and made a partial payment. However, the claim could not be fully processed due to missing information.
artefact.why_adjusted: The claim was adjusted because it lacked necessary information, which is required for processing. This is indicated by the code for missing or incomplete information. As a result, the claim could not be fully paid.
artefact.amounts_note: The allowed amount, the amount your plan paid and the amount you owe are not available on this claim yet. Call Summit Employer Health Member Services at 1-800-555-0177 for the latest status.
next_steps: Contact the provider's billing office to correct and resubmit the claim.
You can also call Summit Employer Health Member Services at 1-800-555-0177 with your claim number for further assistance.
artefact.appeal_rights_summary: If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to appeal. You must file your appeal within 45 days. To start an appeal or ask questions, call Summit Employer Health Member Services at 1-800-555-0177.

artefact.service_description: A professional service provided by Summit Occupational Health on November 22, 2025.
artefact.plain_language_summary: Your claim for a service received was partly paid by your plan. The total billed was $285.00, but the plan only allowed $165.00 for this service.
artefact.what_happened: The plan paid $132.00 of the allowed amount, and you are responsible for the remaining $33.00.
artefact.why_adjusted: The claim was adjusted because the provider billed more than the plan's allowed amount for this service. This means the plan only pays based on what it allows, not the full billed amount.
next_steps: You can review your Explanation of Benefits (EOB) for details.
If the provider is out-of-network, they may bill you for the remaining amount.
If you have questions, call Summit Employer Health Member Services at 1-800-555-0177 and have your claim number ready.
